# Which release, and which complaint, is costing your app stars?

> Free app review analyzer: drop in your Google Play or App Store review CSV and see which release dropped your rating, which complaints cost the most stars, and which unhappy reviews you have not answered. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
